text:
alex: quick heads-up — saw p99 jump in canary after runtime v2.3.1 deploy. Under high concurrency (>800) p95 went 85ms->120ms, p99 210ms->480ms :eyes:

maria: ugh. is this KV-related? any obvious evict spikes?

alex: yes — profiler shows KV cache miss rate up ~3.8x and eviction rate spike coincident with the latency tail. adaptive batching also reacted, shrinking avg microbatch size.

sunil: can you share the profile and kernel selection logs? need to know if kernels are falling back on reference paths.

alex: pasted the quick snippet from the canary host below:

```
KV: cache_size=1.2GB evict_hysteresis=0.05 evicts/sec: 152 -> 610
Batching: adaptive_gate=0.45 -> avg_microbatch=4.2
Kernel selection: primary=o1_fused, fallback=o0_reference on cache_miss
Observed: p95=120ms p99=480ms under conc~1000
```

jess: if kernel falls back on o0_reference for cache misses that's expensive (more memcpy + no fused kernels). Two levers: raise adaptive gate so MB sizes go up (avg_mb 8-12) OR increase eviction_hysteresis to avoid thrashing. Also consider pinning to a kernel variant that tolerates sparse KV hits.

maria: can we reproduce in perf lab deterministically? if yes I'll run a sweep (hotset churn + conc ramp).

alex: reproduced locally. command I used to reproduce the hotset churn:

```
./perf-run --clients=1200 --seq-len=512 --hotset=20% --kv-key-dist=zipfian --duration=10m
```

ci-bot: perf-test/1745009999 completed — p99 regressed by 2.3x, detailed logs: https://s.redwood/perf/1745009999

sunil: suggestion for canary config patch: set adaptive_gate_min=0.6 and evict_hysteresis=0.15, plus kernel_pin=quant_fast for model:xyz. That should reduce fallback rate and increase average microbatch.

jess: +1. Also add an alert on kernel_fallback_rate and kv_eviction_rate so we detect regressions earlier.

alex: applying canary with: adaptive_gate_min=0.6, evict_hysteresis=0.15, kernel_pin=quant_fast. Monitoring p95/p99 and kv_miss metrics now.

maria: noted — will hold promotion until stable for 30m.

alex: update @10m: p95=95ms p99=205ms, kv_eviction_rate down ~4x, avg_microbatch=9.2 :tada: 

sunil: nice work. follow-up: add a perf regression test that simulates hotset churn and asserts p99 < 250ms at conc=1200.

jess: created issue #987, assigned to eng-runtime, attached minimal repro and the perf-run command.

alex: closing loop — will add safer defaults for adaptive_gate_min and evict_hysteresis in runtime config to reduce surprise regressions, and a dashboard tile for kernel_fallback_rate.

maria: thanks all. good quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
